CustomField.description: Confidential narrative for a Sensitive activity (e.g. donation amounts, specific negotiations). Capped at 255 chars: the Activity (Task/Event) object does not support Long Text Area fields, only Text/TextArea. FLS = no access on every profile, including System Administrator; visibility is granted only via the DWD_Sensitive_Activity_Details permission set. Written through the system-context "Task - Autolaunched - Commit Sensitive Detail" subflow so an unauthorized enterer never gains read access.
CustomField.label: Sensitive Details
